source_of_request: User relayed Claude review recommendations; quoted approval example is not human acceptance.

ascent_fit_gates.metric: sqrt(equal mean of nonempty five-second-bin mean squared errors); separate frozen altitude/speed masks; all point residuals also reported

non_fitted_booster_gates.basis: previously_seen_processed_display_and_derived_estimates; not blind or independent model validation
non_fitted_booster_gates.candidate_lock: Freeze selected candidate ID, source, profile and fit results hashes BEFORE computing/scoring booster outcomes. These gates do not rank or select candidates.

altitude_maximum.metric: absolute difference between simulated pre-first-contact maximum altitude and engineering target; preserve numerical peak resolution and displayed-maximum limitation

descending_40000m_crossing.selection: first downward crossing of40000m after the pre-first-contact altitude maximum; bracket by finite physical samples and interpolate linearly; no extrapolation

non_fitted_booster_gates.joint_gate: both numeric gates must pass for these non-fitted checks to pass; report baseline and selected candidate separately; physical recovery acceptance remains independently required
non_fitted_booster_gates.unchanged_recovery_gate: keep registered contact speed, tilt, body rate, reserves and record validity requirements; timing agreement does not make an impact successful recovery
non_fitted_booster_gates.contact_time_approx_415_420s: report only until separately evidenced/registered; do not treat rounded zero altitude as precise contact
non_fitted_booster_gates.failure_action: preserve failed or mixed downstream check; no candidate reselection, grid expansion, retuning or repeat to match these values
non_fitted_booster_gates.later_stage_data_use: if stage2c fits these values, they cease to be non-fitted for2c onward; do not replace stage2b results

adjustable_parameter_limit.stage2b_scope: whole stage including stack/Ship pitch, cutoff and two-stage insertion; not6per subsystem
adjustable_parameter_limit.tied_parameters: one shared scalar counts once only when tying equation and all fixed knot times are frozen before execution
required_before_execution: finite candidate values or fixed bounded grid
fixed functional family and knot count
list of fixed constants and source hashes
computed independent scalar count no greater than6
adjustable_parameter_limit.no_hidden_dof: Do not hide adjustable gains, schedules or coefficients behind a functional family selector or fixed-parameter label. New discretionary parameters require separate registration, never result-dependent changes.
adjustable_parameter_limit.source_based_physics: stage2a sourced inputs are frozen, not fit variables; mass, thrust and geometry must not be moved to improve residuals

execution_budget: No execution by this supplement. Preserve existing stage ceilings until a separately source/environment-bound runner registration fixes exact runs/time before execution; no result-dependent increase.

frame_consistency_note.limitation: Velocity frame transformation depends on position, direction and rotation, not subtraction of one scalar rotation speed. Exact contemporaneous altitude/state and display semantics have not been established; working assumption remains conditional.
